description: Live traffic cameras (Sydney Metro) is a dataset listed in Bayside open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This dataset is linked to the following visualization: Visualization - Live traffic cameras (Sydney Metro) Live traffic cameras in on NSW roads, including location and current images captured by cameras - data feed provided by NSW Transport. Coverage: Bayside, New South Wales. The portal files it under Transport, Movements. Its keywords are transport, traffic, road, monitoring, disaster dashboard, emergency. The portal shows 79 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2015-08-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-nsw-bayside-portal.
